summary: [Shopify] capabilities: GraphQL Admin API for new work (new features ship here first). Mutations: productCreate/Update, draft-order orderCreate, fulfillmentOrder workflows, inventoryAdjustQuantities, discount codes, metafield writes, customer updates. Bulk operations for large reads/writes (async, budget-friendly). Storefront API is customer-facing (separate surface). Shopify Functions extend checkout without rebuilding it.
